note: Primitive DNR state forest campground in the woods beside the public landing on Mantrap Lake, a designated muskie lake, with a swimming area, dock, picnic sites and a 1-mile nature trail. Sites are a cleared area with fire ring and table. No ATVs. --Claude
summary: DNR re-read: 36 drive-in sites (2 accessible), vault toilets, well water, $17 tax-included, same-day online payment (old 'paid at the campground' was wrong). Manager Itasca State Park 218-699-7251. Not waterfront confirmed on imagery (loops ~90 m+ from the shore through forest). Pin matches DNR point. Website to hyphen form.
